insights.topic: Verified purchase data vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: The protocol has crossed $201K in 14-day verified GMV across 4,380 receipts — each one a cryptographically confirmed transaction, not an inferred intent signal. For brands paying $5+ CPM to reach people who might buy, this represents a structurally different data asset: deterministic purchase proof at category and brand resolution.

insights.topic: Grocery dominance with high-value unknown category
insights.insight: Grocery-supermarkets leads at 27.7% of receipts (1,215 receipts, $53K GMV), but the Unknown category produces the highest average ticket — $93 per receipt versus $32–$48 across named categories — suggesting either high-value verticals or premium retail not yet classified; brands in those segments should monitor for attribution as categorization matures.

insights.topic: Chase entry as financial services signal
insights.insight: Chase appeared on the thresholded top brand list at 22 receipts in the 14-day window — the first financial services brand to clear the minimum count floor alongside physical retailers like Walmart (309) and Kroger (142). Whether Chase represents card-linked transaction data or co-branded retail receipts, it signals a potential expansion of the receipt universe beyond physical goods into financial services.

insights.topic: Weekly GMV cycle pattern and demand baseline
insights.insight: Seven confirmed UTC midnight rolloff cycles show a consistent floor-to-ceiling recovery pattern; the most recent cycle hit the deepest trough ($59K) and then the fastest recovery to a cycle-high pre-rolloff peak ($83K), indicating the underlying demand base is growing even as intraday volatility widens — a sign of increasing network utilization, not instability.

The sats-per-receipt rate has moved inversely with BTC price across every observed adjustment, maintaining a near-constant dollar value per receipt regardless of crypto volatility. For brands evaluating this as a data-purchase or incentive rail, the economic exposure is to dollar-denominated cost, not BTC price swings.

insights.topic: Payout freeze as structural risk flag
insights.insight: 809 total payouts and 15.4M sats claimed have not changed across the entire observation window despite continued receipt accumulation — meaning the settlement layer is not clearing. Brands considering this protocol for consumer incentive programs or data licensing should treat the payout freeze as an unresolved operational risk until a structural explanation is disclosed.
